lists.summary: Quantize a checkpoint and prove it still passes: content-hash de-leaked dataset preparation, AWQ/INT4 via llm-compressor inside a container, accuracy comparison on a fixed eval set, and an explicit failure verdict instead of a silent regression.
lists.entry: - [xiciyang/inference-quantization](https://github.com/xiciyang/inference-quantization) - Quantize a checkpoint and prove it still passes: content-hash de-leaked dataset prep, AWQ/INT4 via llm-compressor inside a container, accuracy comparison against a fixed eval set, and an explicit failure verdict instead of a silent regression; declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `engines.dsh`, verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (146 tests).\n
lists.entryZh: - [xiciyang/inference-quantization](https://github.com/xiciyang/inference-quantization) - 量化一个 checkpoint 并证明它仍然达标：内容哈希去泄漏的数据集准备、容器内 AWQ/INT4（llm-compressor）、固定评测集精度对比，失败时给明确结论而不是静默退化；声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `engines.dsh`，已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 验证（146 项测试）。\n

lists.summary: Quantization with a verdict: prepare a de-leaked dataset, run AWQ/INT4 in a container with the source checkpoint mounted read-only, compare accuracy against a fixed eval set, and fail loudly when the tolerance is missed.
lists.entry: - [inference-quantization](https://github.com/xiciyang/inference-quantization) - Quantization with a verdict: de-leaked dataset preparation, AWQ/INT4 via llm-compressor in a container (source checkpoint mounted read-only), accuracy comparison against a fixed eval set, and an explicit failure when the tolerance is missed; declares `dsh.bundle.patch` plus `engines.dsh`, verified against DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (146 tests).\n
